MASTER SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

This Master Subscription Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of
January 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Northstar Analytics Inc.
("Vendor") and Brightline Retail Group ("Customer").

1. SERVICES PROVIDED

1.1 Platform Access. Vendor shall provide Customer with access to the
Northstar Analytics Platform (the "Platform"), a cloud-based data
analytics and reporting software-as-a-service product, for a term of
twelve (12) months beginning on the Effective Date.

1.2 Onboarding Services. Vendor shall provide a one-time onboarding
package consisting of initial data migration, account configuration, and
two (2) training sessions for Customer's staff. Onboarding Services shall
be completed within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date and represent
a distinct deliverable separate from ongoing Platform Access.

1.3 Premium Support. Vendor shall provide Premium Support for the
duration of the Term, consisting of 24/7 phone and email support with a
four (4) hour response time guarantee. Premium Support is available
throughout the Term and is billed as part of the annual subscription fee.

2. FEES

2.1 Total Annual Fee. Customer shall pay Vendor a total annual fee of
$96,000 for the Term, payable in equal quarterly installments of $24,000.

2.2 Fee Allocation. Of the total annual fee, $12,000 is specifically
allocated to Onboarding Services (a one-time fee, itemized separately on
Vendor's invoice), and the remaining $84,000 is allocated to Platform
Access inclusive of Premium Support, billed ratably over the Term.

3. TERM AND RENEWAL

3.1 Initial Term. This Agreement shall remain in effect for twelve (12)
months from the Effective Date (the "Term"), after which it shall
automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods unless
either party provides sixty (60) days written notice of non-renewal.

4. ACCEPTANCE AND DELIVERY

4.1 Onboarding Completion. Onboarding Services shall be deemed complete
upon written confirmation from Customer that data migration and training
sessions have concluded, which the parties agree shall occur no later
than the 30-day onboarding period specified in Section 1.2.

4.2 Platform Access Delivery. Customer shall have continuous access to
the Platform throughout the Term, with Vendor providing an uptime service
level of 99.5% measured monthly.

5. GENERAL PROVISIONS

5.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the
State of Delaware.

5.2 Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement
between the parties regarding the subject matter herein.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the
Effective Date.
